acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
cleavage agent: The band corresponding to the molecular weight of monoubiquitin was excised for in-gel digestion with Asp-N at 37 °C for overnight.
collision energy: Fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energy of 35% and an activation time of 0.1 ms.
enrichment method: ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads
fractionation method: the Lbpro*-treated reaction was separated by SDS-PAGE
fragmentation method: The ten most intense ions were sequentially isolated for HCD MS/MS fragmentation
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer
connected to the LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron, Bremen, Germany)
ionization type: NanoLC−nanoESI-MS/MS analysis was performed on a nanoAcquity system
labeling: For label-free quantification, precursor ions intensities were extracted using Minora Feature Detector node in Proteome Discoverer
reduction reagent: The mixture was treated with 50 µM Lbpro* in a buffer containing 50 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: The mixture was treated with 50 µM Lbpro* in a buffer containing 50 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 10 mM DTT
